description: Decrypted plaintexts of the official TTLock app managing fingerprints on an SN478_PV53 (Android HCI log, decoded with ttlock_btsnoop_decode.py), captured 2026-11-25. Authentication frames and the trailing CHECK_USER_TIME/CHECK_RANDOM/CALIBRATE_TIME after an enrollment are omitted. RX values are RESPONSE (0x54) payloads; progress and completion are unsolicited RESPONSE frames. The byte after the echo and status is the battery level. Fingerprint ids are kept as captured (not sensitive).

frames.meaning: sub-op 2 (add), op 1: enter add mode (no sub-op 4 before it)
done: new fingerprint id (4 bytes) + slot (2 bytes)

operations.note: No validity command follows a permanent enrollment.

frames.meaning: sub-op 2 (add), op 1: enter add mode (no sub-op 4 before it)
done: new fingerprint id (4 bytes) + slot (2 bytes)

operations.operation: enroll, no finger placed (three attempts, identical)

frames.meaning: about 8.4 s later: failure status, error 0xE4; the lock ends add mode by itself

operations.note: 0xE4 is not found in the SDK material available to us; observed as the lock's own enrollment timeout. A single finger placed within about 5 s afterwards was not enrolled.

operations.operation: enroll the same finger again (already enrolled with a date range and a weekly window)

frames.meaning: sub-op 2 (add), op 1: enter add mode (no sub-op 4 before it)
done: new fingerprint id (4 bytes) + slot (2 bytes)

operations.note: The lock created a second, separate, permanent entry with a new id; the restricted entry kept its dates and window. The finger then opened the lock outside the restricted entry's window. The app reported success.
A bare 04 is clear-all. The current app never sends it when enrolling (SN478 and SN484).
